items.raw_excerpt: Lady Elliot Island sat bare, bleak and silent for 100 years after guano miners ravaged it, leaving a moonscape devoid of life. Then in the 1960s, one family started planting trees.
items.summary_en: Lady Elliot Island was left bare and lifeless for 100 years after guano miners stripped it. In the 1960s, one family began planting trees there. Today the island is green again and birds have returned.
items.summary_ko: 레이디 엘리엇 섬은 구아노 채굴로 100년 동안 민둥산처럼 황폐해졌다. 1960년대에 한 가족이 이 섬에 나무를 심기 시작했다. 지금은 섬이 다시 푸르러졌고 새들도 돌아왔다.
items.title_en: Family turns bare island into reef oasis after guano mining destroys it
items.title_ko: 한 가족이 황폐해진 섬을 다시 살아 있는 섬으로 바꿔 놓았다

items.raw_excerpt: In his latest Postcard from Mexico, Ethan Jacobs explores an "only in Mexico" phenomenon: the Noche de Despecho, or "Night of Spite."
items.summary_en: A writer looks at a fun tradition found only in Mexico. It is called Noche de Despecho, or Night of Spite. People turn a sad breakup into a big party together.
items.summary_ko: 한 작가가 멕시코에서만 볼 수 있는 재미있는 풍습을 소개했다. 실연의 아픔을 파티로 바꾸는 '데스페초의 밤'이다. 사람들은 슬픔을 함께 나누며 즐거운 시간을 보낸다.

items.title_original: Postcards from Mexico: Noche de Despecho, or where heartbreak becomes a party

items.raw_excerpt: Eric Lander's eye for on-trend colours has helped him turn a struggling Taranaki sheep farm into a large orchid nursery which sends off exotic blooms to top florists in New York and around the world.
items.summary_en: Eric Lander runs a large orchid nursery in Taranaki, New Zealand. He sends exotic flowers to top florists in New York and around the world. He changed a struggling sheep farm into this business.

items.raw_excerpt: When a young English lawyer crossed paths with a Polish sailor aboard a clipper ship at Port Adelaide in 1893, neither of them was a public figure. Only later did John Galsworthy and Joseph Conrad become two of the most lauded authors of their time.
items.summary_en: In 1893, a young English lawyer and a Polish sailor met on a clipper ship at Port Adelaide. They were John Galsworthy and Joseph Conrad, who later became famous authors. Their meeting led to a Nobel Prize and the film Apocalypse Now.

items.title_en: Two famous writers met on a ship in Port Adelaide

items.title_original: Two men met on a Port Adelaide ship — a Nobel and Apocalypse Now ensued

items.raw_excerpt: Newfoundlander Paul Matthews picked up the phone last month, not knowing it was Jax Irwin on the other end. Irwin cold calls people on the east coast, just to chat. But that day, she had Hollywood star Josh Hartnett and the cast of a new Netflix show on the line with her.
items.summary_en: Paul Matthews lives in Newfoundland. Last month he answered a random phone call. On the line were actor Josh Hartnett and the cast of a new Netflix show. A woman named Jax Irwin often cold calls people on the east coast just to talk. That day she had the stars call with her, and Paul simply went along with it.
